sophia: Quick heads-up — seeing a p95 latency spike in APAC for Qwen-32k quant4a on MI300 pools. Was running the regional longseq sweep earlier.

amit: repro steps?

sophia: ran the baseline generator with ctx=32k, batch=1, prompt len~2k. p50 ~120ms, p95 jumped to 1.2s in ap-northeast-1. eu-west stays ~140ms/160ms.

jorge: did the kernel selection fall through to generic attention? I remember a fallback when ROPE vs GQA mismatch.

luca: can you paste the bench output?

ml-bench-bot: summary: model=Qwen-32k quant=quant4a hw=MI300 region=ap-northeast-1 p50=120ms p95=1.2s tokens/s=85 threads=1 kernel=fallthrough_generic

sophia: pasted log snippet: ```kernel_select: try=hf_rope_gqa optimized=false -> fallback=generic_attention; exec_time=1.18s p95 sample```

amit: OK that matches. MI300 compile used new aten kernel but our kernel matcher didn't pick Qwen-rope variant for that quant path. Likely mismatched posenc tag (seq_type:GQA vs model tag:rope).

jorge: we've seen similar on A100 when sequence policy changes. Fallback adds a big constant overhead per token for KV shuffle.

luca: quick mitigation — force kernel_policy=prefer_optimized for qwen-32k quant4a in ap region? or pin to quant4mi if acceptable quality-wise.

amit: for short term, set routing policy: prefer eu for Qwen-32k-heavy requests (lower p95). I'll trigger a canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: route-change qwen-32k ap->eu for 10% traffic. ID=canary-2143628815

ml-bench-bot: recommendation list: ["add posenc tag normalization during model on-boarding","add kernel matcher test for quant4a+GQA","add perf regression alert for p95 region deltas >3x"]

jorge: also add a micro-benchmark harness that exercises long prompt lengths with cold KV to catch compile-time fallbacks. Minimal harness in tools/bench/longctx_bench.py.

sophia: noted. I'll open an onboarding bug with repro and attach logs + kernel dump. +cc @luca @amit

luca: thanks — assigning to eng-ml oncall, priority=P2.

sophia: end of thread — will follow up with PR for kernel matcher normalization and a short run of quant4mi to compare quality delta. :eyes:
